subject: Post-call enrollment checkpoint: supplier forms & banking details
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sophie Lambert <sophie.lambert@hawthornebio.com>; Procurement Team <procurement@hawthornebio.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-12T15:10:00Z
Subject: Post-call enrollment checkpoint: supplier forms & banking details

Hi Sophie / Procurement team — thanks again for the time earlier. Quick recap + proposed next steps so we can keep the MAP moving toward the target close: August 27th.

Recap (30-min call):
- Agreed scope: Dedicated inference capacity for clinical summarization workloads (P0: PHI redaction, P1: model tuning).
- Procurement path: Hawthorne uses Ariba; they can also accept Coupa but prefer Ariba.
- Documents needed from Hawthorne: W-9 (completed), vendor remit/banking details, PO contact, and a signed MAP.
- Redwood owners: Evelyn (deal owner / MAP coordination), Marcus (legal & SOW), Ben (onboarding ops).

Proposed MAP milestones (draft attached as MAP_draft_Hawthorne_v1.pdf):
1) Vendor enrollment request submitted to Hawthorne Ariba — owner: Sophie / Procurement — due: 2026-08-17
2) Redwood returns completed vendor packet + W-9 to Procurement — owner: Evelyn — due: 2026-08-18
3) Ariba supplier record created and vendor code issued — owner: Procurement — due: 2026-08-21
4) Banking details & ACH test completed — owner: Hawthorne Finance — due: 2026-08-24
5) Signed MAP + PO issuance — owner: Hawthorne Legal / Procurement — target close: 2026-08-27

Dependencies / risks:
- Ariba intake approval can take 3–7 business days once submitted (procurement queue dependent).
- Banking/ACH steps sometimes require vendor form back-and-forth; recommend providing the banking_instructions_template.xlsx to speed this up.

Action items for you: can you confirm the single point of contact in Procurement for the Ariba submission (name and email), and whether Hawthorne requires an RFQ/registration step before vendor enrollment?

I attached a draft MAP and a W-9 request form to streamline. Happy to hop on a 15-min follow-up tomorrow if helpful.

Thanks,
Evelyn Hart
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
E: evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com | M: +1-415-555-0142

Attachments: MAP_draft_Hawthorne_v1.pdf (draft MAP), Redwood_W9_request_form.pdf (fillable), banking_instructions_template.xlsx (optional template)

From: Sophie Lambert <sophie.lambert@hawthornebio.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@hawthornebio.com>, James Ortiz <j.ortiz@hawthornebio.com>
Date: 2026-08-13T09:22:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-call enrollment checkpoint: supplier forms & banking details

Thanks Evelyn — great summary. Quick answers below: 

- Procurement POC: James Ortiz (j.ortiz@hawthornebio.com) will submit in Ariba. He handles vendor onboarding.
- Hawthorne does not require an RFQ for this vendor class; we still need a completed W-9 and vendor remit info to create the supplier record.
- Timeline looks feasible; James asked if Redwood can provide a completed vendor packet (W-9 + vendor profile) in a single PDF to speed the intake.

I’ll flag the MAP to James and loop back once the Ariba request is in queue.

— Sophie
Head of Partnerships | Hawthorne Bio

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: James Ortiz <j.ortiz@hawthornebio.com>
Cc: Sophie Lambert <sophie.lambert@hawthornebio.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-13T11:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-call enrollment checkpoint: supplier forms & banking details

Hi James — thanks for stepping in. Attaching the completed vendor packet (MAP_draft_Hawthorne_v1.pdf includes the vendor profile section we ask customers to confirm).

Two quick asks to make Ariba submission smooth:
- Please confirm the required field for "Tax Classification" in Ariba (some customers have an internal dropdown that needs exact wording).
- If Ariba requires a backup W-9 upload separately, let us know and we’ll send the W-9 as a separate PDF (Redwood_W9_request_form.pdf).

We can also provide the banking_instructions_template.xlsx prefilled if Hawthorne prefers.

Best,
Evelyn

From: James Ortiz <j.ortiz@hawthornebio.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>, Sophie Lambert <sophie.lambert@hawthornebio.com>
Date: 2026-08-14T16:48:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-call enrollment checkpoint: supplier forms & banking details

Evelyn — thanks. Confirming: Ariba field is "Tax Status" with values: "US Corporation", "Foreign Entity", "Individual", etc. We can accept the W-9 as a single PDF attachment.

I submitted the vendor request just now (Ariba ticket #ARB-59412). Estimated processing 3–5 business days. I’ll update the thread when a vendor code is created.

-James

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sophie Lambert <sophie.lambert@hawthornebio.com>, James Ortiz <j.ortiz@hawthornebio.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-16T11:02:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-call enrollment checkpoint: supplier forms & banking details

Appreciate the update, James. Two small clarifications from Legal/Finance side before you finalize the vendor record:

1) Please confirm the remit address on file (physical remit vs. electronic ACH). If electronic ACH is preferred, we will send Redwood's ACH authorization form to Hawthorne Finance to complete.
2) For the MAP signature step: would Hawthorne prefer DocuSign or a countersigned PDF? We can do either; DocuSign is quicker for audit trails.

If you get the vendor code this week we’ll schedule onboarding ops (Ben) to kick off the Ariba test orders and baseline provisioning. Targeting final MAP sign and PO issuance on 2026-08-27 as discussed.

Thanks all — Marcus Lin
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
